# The Cell mode the core derives from a declaration's chains; no host sends one.
#
# `shape` is a row in the step vocabulary of `reference_topologies.txt`: two
# tasklets hang off the same entry channel, and only the one its chain reaches
# through `key` is dynamic. Then `tasklet|mode`, one per tasklet.
#
# Two readers pin it: `flz_core/src/host/check_tests.rs` derives the shape, and
# the Java SDK's `HostClassDeclarationTest` builds it and reads the modes the
# core answered.

shape|entry(in); in.key.into(second); in.into(plain)
second|dynamic
plain|single
